text.title: Evolutionary Architecture Fitness Functions — Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the fitness-function suite spec this methodology produces: one entry per architectural characteristic with metric, unit, tool, verbatim command, threshold, dated baseline, ratchet mode, blocking/informational and triggered/continual classification, owner; plus the suite-level dependency graph, results time series and review cadence. Validator in scripts/validate-evolutionary-architecture-fitness-functions.py enforces it, including the one-fifth manual cap.

required.field: kebab-case id of the suite; prefix `ff-`
the service or codebase the suite guards, as named in the service catalogue
suite owner as `role:handle`; a team alias is rejected (r-ff-owner-and-review-cadence)
the allowed dependency direction written in the spec, not only in the tool config: `layers[]` and `allowed_edges[]` of `{from, to}` (r-ff-structural-dependency-function)
where every run's measured value lands: `location`, `keyed_by` = `["function_id", "commit"]`, `retention_days` at least the review horizon (r-ff-results-trended)

at least one entry; at least one entry has `kind: structural`; per entry: `id`, `characteristic`, `metric`, `unit`, `kind`, `mode`, `tool`, `threshold`, `baseline`, `threshold_mode`, `consequence`, `trigger`, `scope`, `owner`, `consecutive_red_reviews`

forbidden.pattern: a function whose `characteristic` is an adjective or -ility with no metric ("maintainability", "scalable", "clean") — fm-aspiration-not-metric
`mode: automated` with no verbatim `command`, or `mode: manual` with no `review_cadence` — fm-manual-only-suite
more than one fifth of `functions[]` with `mode: manual` — fm-manual-only-suite (cross-field; enforced by the validator, not expressible in the schema)
`threshold_mode: absolute` while `baseline.value` violates the threshold today, or `threshold_mode: ratchet` with no `absolute_from` — fm-threshold-fails-today
`scope: holistic` with `trigger: triggered` (a load test or chaos run in the pull-request path) — fm-holistic-in-pr-path
no entry with `kind: structural`, or `dependency_graph.allowed_edges` empty — fm-no-structural-guard
`consecutive_red_reviews` of 2 or more with no `action` (fix | rebaseline | delete) — fm-orphaned-red-check

output-contract.example: { "suite_id": "ff-billing-service", "system": "billing-service", "owner": "arch:alice", "dependency_graph": { "layers": ["api", "domain", "persistence"], "allowed_edges": [{"from": "api", "to": "domain"}, {"from": "domain", "to": "persistence"}] }, "results_store": { "location": "prometheus://ci-metrics/fitness_function_value", "keyed_by": ["function_id", "commit"], "retention_days": 180 }, "review": {"cadence": "quarterly", "last_reviewed_at": "2026-09-01", "next_review_at": "2026-12-01"}, "functions": [ { "id": "layer-direction", "characteristic": "dependency direction between api, domain and persistence", "metric": "count of imports violating the allowed edges or forming a cycle", "unit": "violations", "kind": "structural", "mode": "automated", "tool": "ArchUnit", "command": "./gradlew test --tests com.acme.billing.arch.LayerRulesTest", "threshold": {"operator": "==", "value": 0}, "baseline": {"value": 0, "measured_at": "2026-09-01"}, "threshold_mode": "absolute", "consequence": "blocking", "trigger": "triggered", "scope": "atomic", "owner": "arch:alice", "consecutive_red_reviews": 0 }, { "id": "core-cyclomatic-complexity", "characteristic": "cyclomatic complexity of billing.core functions", "metric": "count of functions with cyclomatic complexity above 10", "unit": "functions", "kind": "complexity", "mode": "automated", "tool": "lizard", "command": "lizard -C 10 -w src/billing/core", "threshold": {"operator": "==", "value": 0}, "baseline": {"value": 37, "measured_at": "2026-09-01"}, "threshold_mode": "ratchet", "absolute_from": "2027-01-01", "consequence": "blocking", "trigger": "triggered", "scope": "atomic", "owner": "swe:bob", "consecutive_red_reviews": 0 }, { "id": "checkout-p95-latency", "characteristic": "p95 latency of POST /checkout at 200 rps", "metric": "http_req_duration p(95)", "unit": "ms", "kind": "performance", "mode": "automated", "tool": "k6", "command": "k6 run --vus 50 --duration 10m perf/checkout.js", "threshold": {"operator": "<", "value": 400}, "baseline": {"value": 310, "measured_at": "2026-09-01"}, "threshold_mode": "absolute", "consequence": "informational", "trigger": "continual", "scope": "holistic", "owner": "sre:carol", "consecutive_red_reviews": 0 } ] }

list.item: Every function names one characteristic that is not an -ility adjective, one metric and one unit (r-ff-one-attribute-one-metric).
Every automated function carries the verbatim CI command; manual functions carry a review cadence and are at most one fifth of the suite (r-ff-executable-in-ci).
Every threshold sits next to a dated baseline; a baseline that fails the threshold today means `threshold_mode: ratchet` with `absolute_from` (r-ff-threshold-with-baseline-ratchet).
Every function is classified blocking/informational and triggered/continual; holistic functions are continual (r-ff-blocking-vs-informational).
At least one `kind: structural` function exists and `dependency_graph.allowed_edges` is written in the spec (r-ff-structural-dependency-function).
`results_store` is keyed by function id and commit and retained at least the review horizon (r-ff-results-trended).
Every owner is `role:handle`; `review.cadence` is monthly or quarterly; any function at two or more consecutive red reviews carries an action (r-ff-owner-and-review-cadence).
